description:
Get reported 24h volume history. Returns an asset's reported 24h volume in USD over a configurable
lookback window, sampled at a configurable resolution.

Each point is the rolling 24h figure the data provider reported at that
timestamp, not the volume traded inside the bucket. Two adjacent points
therefore overlap by almost a full day.

See the [Time Window & Resolution](#section/Time-Window-and-Resolution)
section for the format of `window` and `resolution`.

asset_id.description: Backend asset ID. Mutually exclusive with `symbol`: exactly one of the two is required, and naming both is a 400.

resolution.description: Bucket size (e.g. `5m`, `1h`, `1d`). Must be at least `1h` for windows over `1d`.

symbol.description: Asset symbol to fetch reported volume for (e.g. `SOL`, `BTC`).

name: get_volume_history
